task_completion.description: Open the 'Fly Brain' sample image from the Fiji/ImageJ samples menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Fiji application window is open showing an image titled 'Fly Brain' with a z-stack slider at the bottom.

task_completion.description: Generate a Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP) and save it as fly_brain_MIP.tif.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new image window titled 'MAX_Fly Brain' (or similar) is visible, and a file saving dialog or a file manager view shows 'fly_brain_MIP.tif' in the results folder.

task_completion.description: Generate an Average Intensity Projection (AVG) and save it as fly_brain_AVG.tif.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new image window titled 'AVG_Fly Brain' (or similar) is visible, and a file saving dialog or a file manager view shows 'fly_brain_AVG.tif' in the results folder.

task_completion.description: Perform an Orthogonal Reslice to create an XZ view and save it as fly_brain_reslice_XZ.tif.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Orthogonal Views' window or a 'Reslice' output window showing a cross-section of the brain is visible, and the file 'fly_brain_reslice_XZ.tif' is saved.

task_completion.description: Create a Montage of the z-stack slices and save it as fly_brain_montage.tif.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window showing a grid of multiple brain slices (a montage) is visible, and the file 'fly_brain_montage.tif' is saved.

task_completion.description: Measure the mean intensity of each slice and save the results as fly_brain_z_profile.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Results' table or 'Plot Profile' window is visible showing values for each slice, and 'fly_brain_z_profile.csv' exists in the results folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the Fiji GUI menus (Image > Stacks, etc.) rather than just command-line file manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the Fiji menu bar being navigated or Fiji-specific dialog boxes (like 'Z Project' or 'Make Montage') active.

integrity.description: The agent accessed the sample through the File > Open Samples menu.
integrity.visual_evidence: The mouse cursor or menu highlighting is seen over 'File' then 'Open Samples' then 'Fly Brain'.

integrity.description: The saved images match the visual characteristics of the Fly Brain sample (nc82/GAL4 staining).
integrity.visual_evidence: The generated projections and montages show the distinct morphology of a Drosophila brain (lobes, central complex) in red and green channels.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Fly Brain' sample is a standard Fiji sample image (flybrain.zip) with dimensions approximately 256x256x57. It features two channels: nc82 antibody staining (green) and GAL4 driver line 78y expression (red). Correct outputs for MIP and AVG should show the full brain structure, while the Z-profile CSV must contain approximately 57 rows of intensity data corresponding to the slices.
